bounds.private_metadata_materialization: Bound raw directory/member counts before materialization and every local span before access; no unbounded lists or raw exception output.
bounds.source_identity: Existing fixed capture size/MD5/SHA256 and same immutable buffer; no new GET or recapture.

dependency_contract: Global malformed/ambiguous central framing prevents later entry association: use a closed incomplete result.
Central metadata predicates may be checked independently once directory records are fully bounded and associated; unsafe names do not authorize unsafe path use or payload opens.
Each local check needs a uniquely associated bounded header offset and fixed header; local variable name/extra spans must be independently bounded before slicing or interpreting them.

Offset/layout, duplicate/overlap or insufficient-bound failures remain failures. A later local check may proceed only under a separately stated safe-address rule; otherwise classify its dependencies NOT_CHECKED. Never reinterpret a mismatch as admission.
Do not derive later addresses by blindly following a failed earlier size/offset. Continue other independently safe entries only.
Local-extra shape checks require a complete bounded local area and reuse the fixed A220/A028/full-zero predicate without changing initial-padding semantics.
Totals/name-based checks require their full inputs; any unsafe/unavailable input makes that family partial rather than passed.
design_goals: Preserve exact G31 first-rejection stage/category equivalence without modifying G31 or running any XML helper.
Produce one aggregate categorical audit over every bounded declared entry, checking all safely evaluable independent families.
Expose unavailable dependencies and partial completion explicitly; do not stop all independent central checks at the first local mismatch.
No acceptance-profile relaxation, source mutation, ordinary spreadsheet loader or generic unzip fallback.
exposure_contract: Whole-buffer target-bearing read is explicit; no no-values-read or untouched-source claim.
Directory-name decoding and each structural stage have started/completed state; aggregate later-entry traversal is a new separately recorded scope.
Local-extra fixed-word and padding interpretation has honest partial progress; no completed-full-traversal flag after failure.
Zero ZIP member opens/decompression, zero XML parsing, zero worksheet/shared-string decoding, no formula evaluation or outcome interpretation.
Repeated identical fixed-source runs are computational replay, not independent scientific evidence.
not_justified: No diagnosis of which specific actual predicate failed from current receipts alone.
No automatic new compatibility profile, payload mutation or scientific admission.
No production binding for the pure documentary worksheet layout candidate because actual G31 remains rejected.
owner: Root owns any later implementation/review/publication/actual operation
prerequisite_and_order: Before production cache access verify exact committed own/source-chain worktree/index/HEAD pins and exclusive fixed output slot.
Require exact observed canonical G31 receipt and producer plus existing original capture/source identities; root must separately verify actual preceding gates.
Read and verify the one bounded immutable source buffer; do not use a receipt alone as source validation.
Recheck G29/G30 selected growth and G31 EOCD/raw central declaration framing; stop safely if these prerequisite facts differ.

Implement exact frozen G31 predicate ordering as a first-rejection classifier, ending before XML even if all header predicates pass. Guard actual observed-source reproduction against any unexpected predecessor outcome.
Independently accumulate closed aggregate categories across all safely evaluable entries. The original first failure remains primary; aggregate findings are supplementary scope.
Close every opened archive on success/failure; cleanup failure preserves prior categories/progress and prevents a complete diagnostic claim.

public_projection.new_source_fields: Closed first-rejection category/stage plus sorted categorical family results and explicit checked/partial/dependency states; no per-entry identity or raw values.
public_projection.no_new_count_inference: Existing three-area counter is not a total member count; do not infer archive totals from partial traversal.
public_projection.source_custody_fields: Already public exact whole-source, capture, producer and prerequisite identities remain permitted.
withheld: entry ordinals or arbitrary metadata strings
raw offsets, sizes, flags, timestamps and CRC fields
local-extra IDs/words/bytes beyond the already retained fixed categorical predicate

required_tests: Independent packed ZIP fixtures isolate every retained predicate family, including the helper path/type checks and final totals.
Exact first-rejection equivalence with frozen G31 across generated single and multiple faults; no XML/member open even on a header-valid fixture.
Simultaneous faults on early and late entries appear in one aggregate audit where safe; unsafe dependencies remain NOT_CHECKED rather than passing.
Offset overflow-like uint bounds, overlapping/duplicate regions, malformed raw central declarations, truncated variable spans and missing required members.
Later malformed local extras after earlier valid areas; all initial-padding values remain semantically unbound.
No raw values, names, member fingerprints or exceptions leak in public categories.
Guard/producer/source/index changes stop before source access; immutable buffer and full cleanup/partial-exposure assertions.
Predeclared mutation controls against skipped families, missing dependency guards and incorrectly promoted aggregate completeness.
